A seasoned warrior with a practical stance and a full set of martial equipment. Source inventory: Shield, Long bow, Arrows, Battle axe, Banded armor. Readied: Shield, Arrows, Battle axe, Banded armor. Source wealth: 1 sp.

IMAGEGEN PROMPT READY:

Input Image 2 is its accepted action sprite for the same warrior and Battle axe + Shield equipment, for identity and axe size only. Input Image 3 is a nearest-neighbor enlargement of Image 1 for inspecting the metal joint. Input Image 4 is the approved independent bipedal pose guide for camera and raised guard only. The current right-hand blade droops toward (57,28), making the head look crooked. Rotate/redraw the metal head UPWARD around its fixed socket by about 30 degrees: make the broad cutting edge on the SCREEN-RIGHT side run from approximately (54,9) to (59,20), above or level with the socket, with NO downward hooked tip below y22. The short rear poll is left of the socket near (38,18). A single solid metal crosspiece passes through the socket; the head must look rigidly attached, with its blade projecting UP-RIGHT toward the target. Preserve a broad readable battle-axe blade, not a sickle, pick, spear, sword, double axe or crescent staff. Keep the complete existing haft length, raised guard and one-handed grip.
Change no pixels of the warrior's face, hair, shoulder, arm, shield, banded armor, quiver, torso, pelvis, boots, both planted-foot coordinates, palette, scale, camera, front three-quarter screen-right facing or 1x1 body footprint. The head may extend into the square above but stays inside the transparent 128x128 PNG margin. Exactly one full-body warrior and one READY frame; no action frame, duplicate, diptych, sheet, extra gear, magic, caption, floor, opaque background, black box, halos or stray pixels.

ACTION INSTALL DECISION: Keep item_003__item_000/action.png byte-for-byte unchanged; keep the long-bow pair unchanged.

FINAL LOCAL PIXEL EDIT: The generator retained the crooked head. The final accepted-ready candidate rotates only the existing independent replacement-art metal axe head 25 degrees around its fixed socket, touching pixels only in x=37..57, y=7..29; hand, haft below socket, shield, body and feet retain their previous pixels.
